edges.reason: packContract parameter is used as the token address pulled by openPacks.
_amount parameter drives how many packs are opened and cards minted.
msg.sender is the source of pack tokens and the mint recipient in openPacks.
cardsPerNormalPack is multiplied with _amount to size the mint loop.
Multiplication _amount * cardsPerNormalPack produces amountBaseCards.
_amount is an operand of the base card count multiplication.
amountBaseCards and amountFounderCards are summed for the array sizing.
Founder card count equals _amount when the founder pack is used.
activeDeck is forwarded to the card dealer in openPacks.
founderPackAddress is compared against packContract to grant founder cards.
normalPackAddress identifies the normal pack contract in openPacks.
cardDealer is invoked from openPacks to draw random cards.
openPacks performs safeTransferFrom on the caller-supplied pack contract.
msg.sender is the from address of the pack token transfer.
openPacks calls cardDealer.randomCards, an external untrusted call.
Dealer-returned baseCards are minted directly to the caller.
amountBaseCards sizes the base card mint loop.
openPacks mints one base card per drawn card id to msg.sender.
msg.sender is the recipient of the minted base cards.
openPacks conditionally mints founder cards when a founder pack is opened.
random() supplies the founder card id minted in openPacks.
amountFounderCards controls how many founder cards are minted.
msg.sender receives the minted founder cards.
openPacks writes the unpacked card ids for msg.sender.
_mint triggers onERC1155Received on the caller contract, re-entering before completion.
Founder card mint also invokes the receiver hook on the caller contract.
_cardsToSwap parameter drives the burn/mint loop of swapCards.
msg.sender is the owner of the swapped cards and the fee payer.
swapFee is compared against msg.value in swapCards.
nftAddress balance check waives the swap fee for NFT holders.
swapCards calls the external cardDealer.randomCards for replacement cards.
swapCards burns the submitted cards and mints the replacement cards.
The submitted card ids are the ones burned in the swap loop.
msg.sender owns the burned tokens and receives the new ones.
swapCards mints to msg.sender, invoking the receiver callback mid-loop.
swapCards overwrites lastUnpackedByAddress with the new card set.
lastUnpackedCards reads the mapping entry for the queried user.
_user selects the mapping entry returned by lastUnpackedCards.
balancesOf sizes its array using totalCards().
_user is the account whose balances are read in balancesOf.
balancesOf fills the balances array with balanceOf results.
The loop counter i iterates over all card ids in balancesOf.
totalCardsOf uses totalCards() as its loop bound.
_user is the account summed in totalCardsOf.
total accumulates balanceOf results inside totalCardsOf.
The loop counter i iterates over all card ids in totalCardsOf.
random() mixes and increments the nonce state variable.
block.timestamp is used as entropy, creating timestamp dependence and weak randomness.
msg.sender is mixed into the pseudo-random seed and is attacker-controllable.
random() derives its result from predictable on-chain values.
_range is the modulus applied to the keccak value in random().
The modulo result is stored in rnd and returned to the caller.
setNFTAddress is gated by onlyOwner, checked against msg.sender.
_nft is written into the nftAddress state variable.
setNFTAddress updates nftAddress, used later for fee waivers.
setSwapFee is gated by onlyOwner, checked against msg.sender.
_fee is written into the swapFee state variable.
setSwapFee modifies the fee required by swapCards.
withdraw_all uses onlyClevel, an authorization check on msg.sender.
withdraw_all transfers the split ETH amounts to both wallets.
The payout sends amountA to walletA via transfer.
The payout sends amountB to walletB via transfer.
withdraw_all computes the split with SafeMath div/mul/sub.
walletBPercentage is a factor of the payout arithmetic.
setWalletA requires msg.sender to equal the current walletA.
_walletA replaces the walletA state variable.
setWalletA updates the payout walletA address.
setWalletB requires msg.sender to equal the current walletB.
_walletB replaces the walletB state variable.
setWalletB updates the payout walletB address.
setWalletBPercentage is gated by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
_percentage is validated and stored in walletBPercentage.
setWalletBPercentage increases the walletB payout share.
Constructor argument _founder initializes the founder pack address.
Constructor argument _normal initializes the normal pack address.
Constructor argument _cardDealer initializes the random card dealer.
Constructor argument _walletA initializes walletA.
Constructor argument _walletB initializes walletB.
The constructor writes founderPackAddress.
The constructor writes normalPackAddress.
The constructor stores the cardDealer interface used for randomness.
The constructor sets the initial walletA payout address.
The constructor sets the initial walletB payout address.

normalization_plan.reason: The pack address parameter only parameterizes the token transfer inside openPacks.
_amount is only meaningful as the iteration bound of the openPacks mint loops.
amountBaseCards is a transient computed size used only inside openPacks.
amountFounderCards is a transient counter local to openPacks.
baseCards holds the dealer output that is immediately minted.
Loop index c exists only to drive the mint loop of openPacks.
Loop index f exists only to drive the founder mint loop of openPacks.
Fcard is the pseudo-random id fed straight into the founder mint.
The submitted card ids are consumed directly by the swap burn/mint loop.
newCards is the dealer output immediately minted in the swap loop.
Loop index c exists only to drive the swap loop.
The user parameter is only a mapping lookup key in the view function.
The user parameter is only the account queried by balancesOf.
The balances array is the return buffer constructed inside balancesOf.
Loop index i only iterates over the card ids in balancesOf.
The user parameter is only the account summed in totalCardsOf.
total is the accumulator local to totalCardsOf.
Loop index i only iterates over the card ids in totalCardsOf.
_range is only the modulus applied inside the random helper.
rnd is the weak pseudo-random value produced from predictable inputs.
The nft parameter is written straight to state by the setter.
The fee parameter is written straight to state by the setter.
The wallet parameter is written straight to state by the guarded setter.
The wallet parameter is written straight to state by the guarded setter.
The percentage parameter is validated and stored by the setter.
The founder pack argument is only used during construction.
The normal pack argument is only used during construction.
The dealer argument is only used to build the dealer interface at construction.
The walletA argument is only assigned during construction.
The walletB argument is only assigned during construction.
